{{Top}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:GorianShard-YearInReview2023.png]] |name=Gorian Shard |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|21}} [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|Gorian Shard's Corsair]], [[Nevarro]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}} |species=[[Gorian Shard's species]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 17: The Apostate}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Green]] |feathers= |eyes=Red |skin=Green |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Gorian Shard's pirate crew]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Pirate King Gorian Shard's name is familiar to all in this sector.|High Magistrate Greef Karga, to Vane|}} '''Gorian Shard''' was a [[Gender|male]] individual of a [[plant]]-like [[species]] who served as the [[Pirate King]] of a [[Gorian Shard's pirate crew|gang]] of [[pirate]]s, which included the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto|Nikto]] [[Vane]], [[Commanding officer|leading]] the gang from his [[Cumulus-class Corsair|''Cumulus''-class Corsair]] [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|warship]]. He was considered one of the most famous pirates in [[the galaxy]]. At some point, Shard obtained treasure, and [[Guild Master]] [[Greef Karga]] used a portion of it to build a [[Nevarro school|cantina]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. In [[9 ABY]], Vane and other pirates under the pirate king's command traveled to Nevarro to speak with Karga, who had become Nevarro's [[High Magistrate]]. Karga and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] [[Death|killed]] several pirates and spared Vane's life, allowing him to flee to the [[Nevarro system asteroid fields|asteroid fields]] in the [[Nevarro system]]. There, the pirate [[Dogfight in the Nevarro system|lured]] Djarin's [[Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter|starfighter]] to the gang's Corsair and Shard, who instructed Djarin to surrender in exchange for his life; however, the Mandalorian did not trust the pirate king and escaped. Bringing his Corsair to Nevarro following his confrontation with Djarin, Gorian commenced an [[Pirate siege on Nevarro|aerial bombardment]] of Nevarro's [[Nevarro City|capital city]]. Djarin returned to the planet with [[The Tribe|other Mandalorians]], who attacked the pirate forces on Nevarro while Djarin [[Space warfare|attacked]] Shard's Corsair. As the Mandalorian forces obliterated the pirate forces, the condition of the pirate king's [[Starship|vessel]] worsened and its [[Cumulus-class snub fighter|starfighter]] [[Vane's Snub Fighter squadron|squadron]] was destroyed by Djarin; as a result, Vane fled Nevarro. Shard, however, did not flee, instead attempting to kill the people of Nevarro; however, Djarin and Mandalorian [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]'s starfighters destroyed the pirate's vessel before he could kill the townspeople, killing Shard. ==Biography== ===King of the pirates=== {{Quote|Stop where you are, Mandalorian. You're outgunned.''"
"''I have no quarrel with you, Gorian Shard.''"
"''Ha! What a kind sentiment from a man who just destroyed four of my fighters. Surrender your ship and I will spare your life.|Pirate King Gorian Shard and Din Djarin|}} Gorian Shard was a [[Gender|male]] [[Pirate King]] from a [[plant]]-like [[species]]{{SW|url=news/who-are-the-pirates-of-the-new-republic|text=Who Arrrrr the Pirates in the New Republic?}} who was the [[captain]] of a [[Gorian Shard's pirate crew|gang]] of [[pirate]]s. He [[Commanding officer|commanded]] several pirates, including the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Vane]], from a [[Cumulus-class Corsair|''Cumulus''-class Corsair]] [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|vessel]]. At some point, the pirate, who hijacked and ransomed, obtained treasure, a portion of which was used by [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] [[Guild Master|Master]] [[Greef Karga]] to build a [[Nevarro school|cantina]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories]]''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' [[planet]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} [[Nevarro]]. [[File:Gorian-Escape.png|thumb|right|300px|Din Djarin's escape angered Pirate King Gorian Shard, who growled after the Mandalorian escaped.]] By [[9 ABY]], the pirate's name was familiar to those who lived in [[Dalicron sector|Nevarro's sector]] and he was considered one of the most famous pirates in [[the galaxy]], tales of Gorian Shard were shared by members of the [[Hunters of the Outer Rim]] tournament on [[Vespaara]].{{HuntersCite|quest=Join the Crew}} In that [[Standard year|year]], Vane and several pirates traveled to Nevarro, where they attempted to [[Diet|drink]] at the [[cantina]] that Karga had built with part of Shard's treasure; however, Karga, who had become a [[High Magistrate]], refused to allow them to drink there, as the establishment had become a school. The pirates confronted Karga, preparing to engage him with their [[blaster]]s; however, the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] and Karga [[Death|eliminated]] all of the pirates—including Shard's [[Gorian Shard's helmsman|helmsman]]—except Vane, who left Nevarro for the [[Nevarro system asteroid fields|asteroid field]] in the planet's [[Nevarro system|star system]]. Setting up an ambush, Shard's Corsair launched several [[Cumulus-class snub fighter|pirate snubfighters]], which [[Dogfight in the Nevarro system|attacked]] Djarin's [[Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter|N-1 starfighter]] after the Mandalorian left Nevarro. Djarin destroyed four pirate starfighters before Vane and other pirates lured him to their captain's Corsair. Shard instructed Djarin to stop, as the Corsair's [[gunwale]] [[laser cannon]]s had locked on the Mandalorian's starfighter and had outgunned the Mandalorian. Djarin claimed that he had no quarrel with the pirate king; however, Shard dismissed his claim, offering to spare the Mandalorian's life if he surrendered his ship. Not trusting the Shard, Djarin ran and escaped to [[hyperspace]], prompting Shard to growl on his ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. ===One last stand=== ====Gorian Shard shot first==== {{Quote|Believe your ears then, and don't mistake my hospitality for weakness.''"
"''Is that what you call gunning down my helmsman in cold blood? When he let down his guard on your planet.''"
"''He shot first.''"
"''Well, now I will shoot first.|High Magistrate Greef Karga and Pirate King Gorian Shard|}} Sometime after the confrontation with Djarin, Shard moved against Karga. As his Corsair entered Nevarro's [[atmosphere]], the pirate king communicated with Karga via [[hologram]]. Shard was surprised to see the former Guild Master in a [[noble]]man's outfit while he heard the former Bounty Hunters' Guild member's voice, announcing that he was going to attack Nevarro. The high magistrate attempted to scare the pirate with king a bluff, commenting that the [[New Republic]]'s [[Spinward patrol]] passed through the area regularly; however, Shard countered that the New Republic could not protect the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] from the [[Pirate Nation]]. Shard mentioned that Karga had killed his helmsman, and the high magistrate told the pirate king that his helmsman shot first, prompting Shard to commence an [[aerial bombardment]] of [[Nevarro City]], the planet's [[capital]], instructing Karga to not hail him again unless he sought to surrender. While the town's people evacuated the city, Karga sent a message to New Republic pilot [[Carson Teva]], asking him to help him defend his world from Shard's forces. [[File:Gorian-Karga.png|thumb|left|300px|Pirate King Gorian Shard confronts High Magistrate Greef Karga via hologram.]] Teva, who believed that the pirate king's attack on Nevarro was connected with [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial]] [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s occupation of the planet and that the two incidents were part of a growing danger, which was true, as Gideon sought to use the pirate siege to attack the New Republic,{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} traveled to the New Republic member planet{{Databank|coruscant|Coruscant}} [[Coruscant]] in an attempt to gather more forces with which he planned to confront Shard; however, as Nevarro was not a member of the New Republic, the government was unable to provide any aid. As Shard's pirates pillaged the city, Teva recruited Djarin and [[The Tribe|other Mandalorians]] to fight Shard's forces. Djarin's N-1 and Mandalorian [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]'s [[Bo-Katan Kryze's Gauntlet starfighter|''Kom'rk'' Class fighter transport]] arrived at Nevarro and moved to attack Shard's Corsair. After Djarin fired at the pirate vessel, Shard commanded his crew to man the gunwales and launch Vane's [[Vane's Snub Fighter squadron|snubfighter squadron]]. Djarin destroyed several fighters and the Corsair proceeded to follow the attacking vessel, leaving Nevarro's capital. ====In a puffer's pig eye==== {{Quote|Sir, we're down to our last engine. We have to retreat.''"
"''In a puffer pig's eye.|A pirate and Pirate King Gorian Shard|}} While Vane's [[squadron]] pursued Djarin's starfighter to the [[Lava fields|lava flats]] under Shard's directive, Kryze's fighter [[transport]] arrived over the city, and two teams of [[Mandalorian warrior]]s jumped from the ship, falling to the city below and attacking the pirate forces in the settlement. Kryze used her{{Databank|bo-katan-kryze|Bo-Katan Kryze}} vessel's cannons to attack the pirate Corsair, destroying one of its [[engine]]s. An [[Unidentified pirate coxswain|Ugnaught coxswain]] reported the condition of the vessel to Shard, who commanded the other to instruct Vane and the other snubfighters to reform for a counter attack. As the Mandalorian warriors eliminated the pirate forces in the city, Kryze and Djarin engaged Vane's squadron, destroying snubfighters, one of which crashed into the Corsair, destroying another engine and damaging the vessel's [[deflector shield]]s. After the coxswain announced the damage the Corsair had suffered, Shard exclaimed the phrase [[dank farrik]]. [[File:Gorian-Helm.png|thumb|300px|right|Gorian Shard removed a pirate from the helm and moved the Corsair to the location of Nevarro's townspeople in an attempt to kill them.]] The Mandalorians circled the remaining pirates and forced them to surrender, and Vane proceeded to flee, telling his pirate king that it had been a pleasure to serve him. As all but one of the Corsair's engines had been destroyed, a pirate crewmember warned that they should retreat; however, Shard removed a [[Warthog (species)|Warthog]] [[Unidentified Warthog pirate|pirate]] from the Corsair's helm and moved the vessel to the location of the townspeople, seeking to kill them. However, the Mandalorian vessels destroyed the pirate [[warship]]'s last engine, and the Corsair began to fall to Nevarro's surface, with Shard screaming as his vessel crashed. Later, the defeat of Gorian Shard and his pirates was reported to Gideon by his agent, Elia Kane, who informed the Moff that the attack on Nevarro had been thwarted by Mandalorian forces commanded by Bo-Katan Kryze and Din Djarin. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Gorian Shard. I knew that Corsair looked familiar.''"
"''I don't believe my eyes. The voice sounds like Greef Karga, Guild Master of the Nevarro Hunters, but all I see before me is a pampered nobleman dressed for the pomp of his wedding feast.|High Magistrate Greef Karga and Pirate King Gorian Shard|}} [[File:GorianShard-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|270px|Gorian Shard was a vengeful pirate king.]] A male [[alien]] pirate with a moss-haired face, Shard grimaced{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 17: The Apostate}} {{AD|Disney+}} when Djarin escaped from Nevarro's [[asteroid field]]s. He had [[Color|green]] hair, green skin, and red [[eye]]s. The pirate king laughed at Djarin when the Mandalorian remarked that he had no quarrel with the pirate king, considering it a "kind sentiment." Vane considered his fellow pirates as his brothers; Shard, however, threw a Warthog pirate away from the helm of the Corsair. When he confronted Karga via hologram, Shard did not believe his eyes, as he saw a pampered nobleman instead of one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's Guild Masters. After a pirate remarked that they should retreat during the battle on Nevarro, Shard was not willing to retreat, dismissing the other's suggestions by saying "in a [[puffer pig]]'s eye." ==Equipment== While sitting on a chair on his Corsair's bridge, Shard held a black staff. He wore a pair of brown [[boot]]s, a black undershirt, and a brown, ornate shirt decorated with a red band. His shirt's left shoulder was decorated with a black [[pauldron]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Meet the new character I play in @themandalorian His name is Gorian Shard. Some say he looks like swamp thing. What do you think? Its ''[sic]'' such fun to be part of!|Nonso Anozie on Instagram|{{Instagram|username=nonso_anozie|url=p/CpTfcb0h4u5|name=[[Nonso Anozie]]|date=2023-03-03|quote=Meet the new character I play in @themandalorian His name is Gorian Shard. Some say he looks like swamp thing. What do you think? Its ''[sic]'' such fun to be part of!|archiveurl=https://archive.is/rpS1s}}}} [[File:Gorian_Shard_concept_art_MandoS3.png|thumb|250px|Gorian Shard concept art by Aaron McBride]] Gorian Shard first appeared in [[Chapter 17: The Apostate]], the seventeenth episode of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]], which aired on [[March 1]], [[2023]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}} He was voiced by [[Nonso Anozie]], with [[Carey Jones]] being the performance artist. Executive producers [[Dave Filoni]] and [[Jon Favreau]] chose to add Gorian Shard into the story.{{SW|url=news/jon-favreau-dave-filoni-interview-the-mandalorian-season-3|text=Jon Favreau and Dave Filoni Chart a Course to Mandalore}} On an [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] post Anozie posted on [[March 2]] of that year, Anozie said that some say Shard looks like [[Wikipedia:Swamp Thing|Swamp Thing]], a [[Wikipedia:DC Comics|DC Comics]] character,{{WebCite|url=http://www.dccomics.com/characters/swamp-thing|text=DC Comics: Swamp Thing|date=2012-02-23|archivedate=20170916225344}} and that it was "such fun to be part of." [[Aaron McBride]] drew two pieces of concept art of Shard on his flagship's bridge.{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-21-the-pirate|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 21: The Pirate"}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Gorian Shard}} *''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]'' {{Mo}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 17: The Apostate}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 3|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 3]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-17-the-apostate-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 17: The Apostate"}} *{{SW|url=news/jon-favreau-dave-filoni-interview-the-mandalorian-season-3|text=Jon Favreau and Dave Filoni Chart a Course to Mandalore}} *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-21-the-pirate-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 21: The Pirate"}} *{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-21-the-pirate|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 21: The Pirate"}} *{{InsiderCite|228|Making History: Five Years of The Mandalorian|Making History: Five Years of ''The Mandalorian''}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{SW|url=news/who-are-the-pirates-of-the-new-republic|text=Who Arrrrr the Pirates in the New Republic?}} *{{Hunters|url=news/season-5-patch-notes|text=Season 5 Patch Notes}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Gorian Shard |es=Gorian Shard |fr=Gorian Shard |ja=ゴリアン・シャード |ka=გორიან შარდი |nl=Gorian Shard |pl=Gorian Shard |uk=Ґоріан Шард }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Shard, Gorian}} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Personnel of Gorian Shard's pirate gang]] [[Category:Pirate monarchs]]
